structured.rankingRationale: OENOVITI ranks first because self-arranged accommodation is explicitly published in the La Côte market. Commissioning/construction/ARCI and IAS follow for segment alignment, dated activity and unconfirmed sourcing. Palexpo events have strong demand mechanisms but committed venues, so they rank as overflow, side-event, relationship or future-edition intelligence rather than open hotel business. Geneva Dry proves hotel buying but is committed to competing hotels.
notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize OENOVITI, commissioning/construction training, ARCI and IAS for direct sourcing verification.
For Palexpo events verify housing/agency arrangements and overflow before outreach.
Track Geneva AI Summit side-event call in early 2027.
materialUncertainties: No candidate has a verified YOTEL room block or confirmed open hotel sourcing unless explicitly stated; silence is not openness.
Committed venues are competitive-market or overflow intelligence, not available inventory.
Most sources do not publish room blocks, buyer authority or participant lodging behavior.
Lausanne is included only with published Geneva Airport transfer evidence.
